goals: Verify the user authentication API, including successful registration, login with token generation, and error handling for incomplete credentials.
Verify the medical professional registration API, ensuring successful registration and proper error handling for incomplete data.
activities: Verify that the Node environment is set to testing
Send a POST request to /api/auth/user-register with new user details
Verify the user registration response status is 201
Send a POST request to /api/auth/user-login with valid user credentials

Verify the user login response text contains a token
Verify the user login response text contains a message

Send a POST request to /api/auth/med-register with complete medical professional details
